durable_findings.finding: An unset/default reasoning effort can appear as none in status while the Ollama request carries an empty reasoning object; explicit none must be configured to disable Qwen reasoning deterministically.
Outer timeout can coexist with invalid tool use, approval-policy mismatch, sandbox failure, repeated retries, and context growth; preserve those signals separately.
Qwen3 0.6B completed within the wall clock but failed deterministic verification, so candidate exit zero is not sufficient for qualification.
Codex 0.154.0 refuses arg0 helper creation when CODEX_HOME is under the system temporary directory; qualification must use a non-temporary Codex home.
The tested GitHub-hosted Ubuntu runner cannot satisfy Codex bubblewrap user/network namespace setup and returns loopback RTM_NEWADDR operation not permitted.
Legacy Landlock is not a transparent substitute for the agent workspace permission profile when Codex requires direct runtime enforcement.

operational_rules: Run a no-model sandbox preflight before downloading or hydrating an expensive model.
Record timed_out separately from underlying failure signals.
Record state_changed independently of candidate exit status.
Keep deterministic verification authoritative for success.
Keep expensive qualification and deep-diagnostic workflows manual-only unless a future trigger demonstrates acceptable cost.
